bio: This small restaurant is located in the Marina Fallenbach clubhouse, on the outskirts of Brunnen. The place has a lovely friendly atmosphere, refined decor and beautiful views of the marina, lake and mountains, not to mention a wonderful terrace! Their modern and cosmopolitan cuisine is made with good, fresh seasonal produce. In addition to à la carte dishes, there is also a three- to five-course seasonal set menu. Inexpensive lunch menu....
